name: Stoppage by the employer’s fault — full contract wage
authority: Labour Code art.99(1); counted service, Decree 145/2020 art.65(9) https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf

name: Stoppage by the worker’s own fault — unpaid, not counted service
Stoppage by another worker’s fault — agreed wage, at least the regional minimum
pay: day.day_type == "WORK" ? max((terms.base_salary / (period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days > 0 ? double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) : double(rules.working_time.fallback_working_days))) * (has(suspension.facts.agreed_pay_percent) ? double(suspension.facts.agreed_pay_percent) : (has(company.facts.stoppage_pay_percent) ? double(company.facts.stoppage_pay_percent) : 100.0)) / 100.0, (double(rules.minimum_wage.by_region[company.region in ["II", "III", "IV"] ? company.region : "I"]) / (period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days > 0 ? double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) : double(rules.working_time.fallback_working_days)))) : 0.0

name: Utility failure, natural disaster, fire, epidemic, enemy action, State-ordered relocation or economic reasons — agreed wage, at least the regional minimum for the first 14 working days
pay: day.day_type == "WORK" ? (double(suspension.working_days_elapsed) <= 14.0 ? max((terms.base_salary / (period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days > 0 ? double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) : double(rules.working_time.fallback_working_days))) * (has(suspension.facts.agreed_pay_percent) ? double(suspension.facts.agreed_pay_percent) : (has(company.facts.stoppage_pay_percent) ? double(company.facts.stoppage_pay_percent) : 100.0)) / 100.0, (double(rules.minimum_wage.by_region[company.region in ["II", "III", "IV"] ? company.region : "I"]) / (period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days > 0 ? double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) : double(rules.working_time.fallback_working_days)))) : (terms.base_salary / (period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days > 0 ? double(period.month_working_days + period.month_holiday_work_days) : double(rules.working_time.fallback_working_days))) * (has(suspension.facts.agreed_pay_percent) ? double(suspension.facts.agreed_pay_percent) : (has(company.facts.stoppage_pay_percent) ? double(company.facts.stoppage_pay_percent) : 100.0)) / 100.0) : 0.0
